name: Inconsistency
overview: Scripture exposes the sin of inconsistency as a failure to align one's actions with God's righteous standards, as seen when Jesus rebuked those who hypocritically judged others while ignoring their own faults. Believers are called to genuine obedience rather than mere external observance, avoiding the heavy burdens imposed by those who do not practice what they preach. This inconsistency not only dishonors God but also brings reproach from unbelievers, emphasizing the need to walk in the fear of God with integrity.
